# lite_ss memory map

Revision r1. System addresses; End is inclusive.

## bus

AXI4-Lite shared-bus, 32-bit data, 32-bit address, D_SYS

| Slave | Region | Base | End | Size | Access | Secure only |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| sram | mem | 0x1000_0000 | 0x1000_3FFF | 0x0000_4000 | RW | N |
| uart | regs | 0x2000_0000 | 0x2000_0FFF | 0x0000_1000 | RW | N |

- cpu: unmapped or blocked accesses get DECERR.
